note: Both sets mix sound dimension extractions with vague entities and invented component/property bindings, but Set A binds more values to the correct detail (e.g., 2'-3 7/8" and 7'-0" to Module A, 3'-8 3/8" to Module B) and captures the L3X3X1/4 angle specification. Set B adds useful facts Set A misses (drawing scale 1 1/2" = 1'-0", 12'-3 3/4" total length of Module A, C1 reference S-301) but misbinds 2'-3 7/8" to Module B and invents properties such as web thickness 5/8", base-block hole offset, and base-plate offsets to center. Set A's errors are mainly vague or duplicated claims (e.g., 'component width 6"', 'dimension length 3'-8 3/8"') plus a few invented entities (I-beam, base plate, base block, upper section), while Set B has more outright invented attribute bindings and one malformed value (6" in).
